Take a look and call me when you decide!

gerente: Hi! I am Ricardo, the branch manager.
I can help with accounts, investments or loans.
The schedule is calm today. Please have a seat.
If you want to meet the team, the office is through the back door.
totem: Ticket A-042. Please wait to be called.

cartoes.dica: The {{total}} Ultra Blue cards are hidden in objects and people, in new places every time the game opens. Get close and press A to search.
cartoes.concluido: You found all the Ultra Blue cards in {{tempo}}. Congratulations!

rici.descricao: Leads Fernanda, Fábio, Garba, André Roxa, Andrea and Roman, and with them the whole UX team. Brings BTG, Pan and Mobiauto into one way of doing design. Clears the path for the team to deliver.

garba.descricao: R$ 1.94 bn in production, above target, and 2.1 M active credit customers. About 80 go!PAN releases, from the dealer journey to payments. Drove C2C and conversational.

rogerio.descricao: Took on the most complex journeys of the year, like agnostic Portability. Brings AI into the UX process with a kickoff agent. Also shipped the Payroll Endorsement Consent.

fernanda.descricao: R$ 10.81 bn in production in Payroll Loans UX, 82.5% of the vertical. Moved the journeys to White Label without stopping the current app. Leads Igor, Denise, Renan and Rogério.

entregas.provisorio: Content coming soon: this board's deliveries will be posted here.

selecao.dica: Arrows or tap to choose, A or Enter to play. Whoever you skip walks around the map.
selecao.dicaTroca: You stay in the same spot, with your cards and time. Whoever leaves walks the map where the new one was.
